changes: Explicit owned LcdClient observation_deadline Option min-merges absolute scopes while sharing provider, namespace and pacing state and preserving cancellation flags.
Data and identity operation deadlines take the earlier owned scope or existing policy total deadline. Intrinsic attempt remains separately bounded.
Producer scopes are established before constructing futures: wrapper poll, separate floor phase, head-local scope, each spawned pair job, and one snapshot-helper scope outside capacity retries.
Identity-only positive completing after its deadline cannot authorize success or reset health. Earlier independently qualified aggregate attestation remains valid; typed negatives retain precedence.
Typed data body/chain/historical/invalid/lag validation precedes the positive-expiry guard. The guard precedes shared actual-height publication and Accepted/BelowMinimum health success.
Within-budget actual observed heads retain the existing generic lag policy even if below a query-specific minimum. Requested minimum is never invented as observed height.
Read-only cfg(test) first-poll accessor supports producer controls; no production counter, RPC, queue, task-local state or detached task is added.
Only the exact internally generated total-deadline string maps to the fixed deadline diagnostic; similar arbitrary messages and known typed negatives preserve their existing classification.

limitations: First polling a transport future does not prove wire delivery; controls deliberately count logical starts separately.
Neither deterministic continuation nor parent-deadline controls prove retrospective provider admission for the M6 live reference failure.
Final source verification is local/synthetic. Full release verifiers, hosted CI and deployed useful-result acceptance remain with the parent.
One existing LCD benchmark remains ignored; no new ignored tests or skip was introduced.
